theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_em_cutoff_tendsto_ball
theorems.statement: ∃ η : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (η j)) ∧ (∀ j u, 0 ≤ η j u) ∧ (∀ j u, deriv (η j) u ≤ 0) ∧ (∀ j u, 1 ≤ u → η j u = 0) ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → μ (ball z s) < ∞ → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, η j (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (μ.real (ball z s)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
